svg.title: Разгибание кистей со штангой — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Two close three-quarter poses, seated on bench, forearms pronated palms DOWN and firmly supported on thighs. Both hands grasp one short straight barbell. Start wrists slightly flexed below thighs, finish wrists extend up while forearms stay on thighs. Emphasize wrist angle, elbows fixed. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
